transactions.description: On 6/1/2021, spouse was granted a Restricted Unit Award of L3Harris Technologies, Inc common stock as part of his compensation pursuant to the provisions of the Harris Corporation 2015 Equity Incentive Plan ( see https://disclosures-clerk.house.gov/public_disc/ptr-pdfs/2021/20018843.pdf ). These RSUs vested on 6/1/2024, were distributed on 6/3/2024 at the end of the day, and were sold as soon as possible on 6/4/2024.
